task: Turn a recording into an .srt subtitle file
packaging_note: No upstream Docker packaging; pip install of the pinned commit with CPU torch and ffmpeg
platforms_tested: linux/arm64 in Docker Desktop on macOS

inputs.what: the recording; any format ffmpeg reads, whatever its extension

known_issues: The base model (139 MB) is baked into the image; pass --model_dir /models or it downloads again
First build takes about 15 minutes, mostly downloading torch

verified.agent: Claude Opus 5.5, running every service from a fresh workspace
verified.evidence: Sample (whisper's tests/jfk.flac, 11 s): 2 cues ending at 11.0 s with both expected phrases; the structural check also passed an unrelated 15.5 s recording under draft 1
